# Primary-host numeric scope acceptance

These are invented engineering fixtures, not historical coursework. On 2026-10-14
the primary Codex host exercised the current compiled CLI in
`/tmp/canvas-host-numeric-MlrtaF`, read ordinary and frozen saved JSON sources and
explicit fixture permission, executed the five calculations, authored this actual
finished candidate, and completed both modes with automatic spreadsheet companions.
The frozen verdict stayed pending-human. The retained candidate substitutes only
the task ID during regression replay; questions/headings are not adapted at runtime.

An initial prompt mentioned both Part 2 and Part 1. Its saved recipe was unscoped,
as documented for multiple named parts. That task was preserved. A fresh fixture
prompt uniquely named Part 2 and called other parts background before the scoped
acceptance run; no private recipe was edited to force scope. An initial calculator
input was a bare array and was rejected. The documented operations object was then
used successfully and is retained here. Neither failure is hidden as a pass.

The result is one primary-host exercise and deterministic fresh-process replays,
not independent grading, a real class/policy test, installed host-plugin discovery,
historical visibility certification or an actual `/goal` controller interruption.
The host checked the synthetic inputs/results and preserved uncertainty; tests
verify scope, structure, numbers, artifacts, retry bytes and frozen-source isolation,
not arbitrary answer quality or numeric grounding from every possible source.

The same primary host also supplied a deliberately flawed draft, read its review
handoff, executed the written expression ($1,000) and incremental-cost expression
($4,000), and authored the retained review note. It identifies arithmetic,
sunk-cost treatment, unsupported confirmed-demand/zero-effect claims and missing
approval evidence without replacing the work or assigning a grade. Regression
replay checks exact saved scope, review-mode headings, supplied-work capture,
calculator results, distinct note, unchanged retries/originals and rejected local
approval. This is another primary-host synthetic exercise, not independent review
or a general guarantee that a host will catch every defect.

The primary host then added the invented marginal-analysis reading, read the
current weekly prep handoff, executed the five scenario calculations again and
authored the retained multi-reading preparation brief. It synthesizes the case
and framework, answers all three posted questions and keeps missing background
and valuation evidence explicit. Replay verifies current source selection,
exclusion of assignment-only preferences and next-week material, exact question
capture, rejection of an omitted question heading, unchanged originals and stable
completion retries. This is prep outcome evidence, not merely a collection of
reading pointers, and remains a primary-host synthetic exercise rather than a
real instructor's evaluation or complete cross-host/corpus certification.

The primary host finally exercised a synthetic local-edit revision and explicit
test approval: it read the captured original/edit/diff/feedback, re-executed the
calculations and authored the complete revised response incorporating the demand-
evidence condition as a supplied preference, not a new forecast or policy. The v2
draft and local Final paired spreadsheets matched; original draft, companion,
edit and parent-record hashes remained unchanged. Replay verifies lineage, diff,
original input capture, revision reuse, paired output/Final bytes, preserved source
history and repeated completion/approval. This is a scoped local fixture workflow,
not actual student/instructor approval, submission or an academic-quality verdict.
